text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, with results like these, there are 
no complaints, right?!
choice_data_list:
Yes, her racing performance was quite 
stable!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It has been proven that my 
theories and physical overhaul were not 
mistaken.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the new model. Let's keep 
up this momentum and master it even 
further.

The progress shown in this 'Upgrade Exam' 
was truly beyond reproach!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"I would like to keep this momentum going 
next time. Shall we hold the next Upgrade 
Exam at the end of the year in December?"

As ST-2 said that, the light in its eyes 
felt unmistakably like the shining 
embodiment of Dr. Wright's will.
